# WaveSync

> WaveSync is a free, open-source web app that plays one local music file in sync across several devices. A host creates a room, guests join with a room code, and the audio is sent directly between devices over encrypted WebRTC. No accounts, and no audio is uploaded to a server.

## Pages

- [Home / app](https://dharshans-code.github.io/WaveSync/): Create or join a room and play music together
- [Privacy Policy](https://dharshans-code.github.io/WaveSync/#privacy): What the app stores and how rooms work

## Code and docs

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/DharshanS-code/WaveSync): Source code, setup and how the sync engine works
- [README](https://github.com/DharshanS-code/WaveSync/blob/main/README.md): Features, local setup, deployment and sync design
